name: @thomasfosterau/prosekit-utilities-monorepo
description: ProseKit document grammars as Effect Schemas, Drizzle document columns, and Svelte 5 editor components — in a Vite+ workspace
author: Thomas Foster <me@thomasfoster.au>

scripts.release: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 exec pnpm pack --out package.tgz && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 exec npm publish package.tgz --access public && changeset tag
